source.note: Search summary (results: Wikipedia, OnTheSnow, PeakVisor, vail.com, Epic Pass pages): 5,317 skiable acres (seven Back Bowls); trails 195 (18% beginner / 29% intermediate / 53% advanced); lift system "31 total" listed as 2 gondolas (12- and 10-person), 4 high-speed six-seat, 14 high-speed quad, 1 fixed-grip quad and 2 fixed-grip triple chairs, and 9 surface lifts — which adds up to 32, not 31. Another result in the same summary said 277 trails and 33 lifts. Season of the figures not stated. Updated 2026-10-03 from the official vail.com homepage stats (read directly): "Lifts: 32 · Runs: 278 · Elevation: Up to 11,570 feet". The ability split comes from the older 195-trail count.

source.note: Piste reference data (not web-verified in this build) — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Slopeside lodging in the Vail Village and Lionshead base areas

character: A very large resort above the town of Vail on I-70 and the flagship of Vail Resorts, with long groomed front-side runs, the open Back Bowls and the separate Blue Sky Basin. Base areas are Vail Village, Lionshead and Golden Peak; it is busy and expensive at peak times.
learning: Reference note: learning terrain has been concentrated at Golden Peak and at Eagle's Nest (top of the Eagle Bahn Gondola), with lessons through the Vail Ski & Snowboard School. Confirm where first-timers start in 2026-27 and the lesson products.

transfers.name: Epic Mountain Express (shared airport shuttle)
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: Vail Resorts' shared-ride shuttle (formerly branded Colorado Mountain Express) has run from DEN and EGE to Vail and Summit County. 2026-27 schedules and fares are unconfirmed.

transfers.name: Bustang (CDOT intercity bus, I-70 West line)
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: CDOT's intercity coach has run along I-70 from Denver with stops including Frisco and Vail. Confirm 2026-27 stops, schedule and fares.

transfers.name: Town of Vail buses
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: free in-town buses link Vail Village, Lionshead and Golden Peak with town lots and neighbourhoods.

transfers.name: Rental car
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: winter driving on I-70 and Vail Pass; Colorado's traction law can apply on I-70 in winter. Check COtrip.
